text_en: Pssst...
Come to speak with the old man? _300_Good luck he's had a bit of an odd day. He's a bit difficult to deal with when he gets all mystical.
Listen to me carefully...
It is difficult to explain, so be prepared to alert your soldiers when I give the signal. We don't have much time.
A few days before your arrival, a substance that I was able to identify as hostile agents fell upon Hafin.
To ward them off, I created a barrier around the entire city that has kept us safe. I had hoped they would eventually leave, but something appears to be keeping them here.
My power is starting to wane, so it won't be long until they arrive.
Be careful. Whatever they are, they weren't brought here by the Valkyries.
I can't hold it much longer...
Old man...?
What?!
AH! MONSTERS!
SOLDIERS, DEFEND THE CITY!
IRONCLADS, GET IN FORMATION!
ON MY ORDERS!
HELP!
No...
The entire city is in danger... Because of me? I must go and help them.
Let's go, Edil!
No!_100_ I'll defend our home!_100_ He'll help me!
Edil, we don't have time! Hafin has never faced anything like this before.
You prepared me for anything, including something like this!
Edil...
Soldier, please, do not let anything happen to her. She's the most precious thing I have...
I will be back as soon as I can.
Is that it?_500_ Was that all of them?
We've defeated them all! Yes!
Although it's almost a shame, I was starting to have fun, he, he...
he...
Huh...?_200_ What's ha...?
EDIL!
EDIL, I'M HERE! PLEASE, SAY SOMETHING!
What's happened? Those things... They must have been able to come into contact with her.
I'm so sorry, Edil... I shouldn't have left your side.
Edil, I can't lose you...
Soldier, I don't hold you responsible. It's all my fault. Despite my years, it appears that I'm still making mistakes...
If you want to help both her and your friends, there is something you can do.
To the east of Hafin, across the plains, you'll find a small orchard with green flowers at the centre: they're called <color=OBJ>Lilis Radiantis</color>.
They..._100_ These are no simple flowers. With them, you'll be able to destroy the agent that's keeping her in this state.
Hurry, we don't know how much longer they'll stay like this. And be careful, we're managing to defend the city, but these things will surely be roaming the surrounding area.
There's something else.
In order to pick them, you'll need to ask the <color=CHA>garden custodian</color> for permission. Don't worry, he'll oblige your request if you present him with <color=IMP>this seal</color>.
